name: agent-loop
description: Multi-agent dev-loop orchestrator: an Overseer plus five specialized worker phases (Planner, Test-Designer, Builder, Verifier, Gatekeeper) built on the Claude Agent SDK, with an indexed changelog store and a live approval UI.

scripts.test: npm run -s test:plumbing && npm run -s test:server && npm run -s test:scope && npm run -s test:data-dir && npm run -s test:safety && npm run -s test:bash && npm run -s test:rules && npm run -s test:terminal && npm run -s test:report && npm run -s test:browser-tools && npm run -s test:browser-cu && npm run -s test:ui && npm run -s test:ui-desktop && npm run -s test:desktop-tools && npm run -s test:desktop-adapter && npm run -s test:desktop-cli && npm run -s test:desktop-pipeline && npm run -s test:insights
scripts.test:desktop-real: bash test/desktop-real.sh test/desktop-real.mjs test/desktop-real-adversarial.mjs && AGENT_LOOP_TEST_NO_WM=1 bash test/desktop-real.sh test/desktop-real-nowm.mjs
